title: 받침 ㄹ: 물, 말, 길
objective: You can read words that end in ㄹ, like 물 and 서울, and tell a final [l] from an initial tap [r].
summary: Read and say the final consonant ㄹ as a clear [l], as in 물, 말, and 길.

task.title: Read, choose, and write
task.line: Say each Korean word out loud first, then answer each part.

letters.as: A clear [l], like the l in 'leaf', but at the end of the syllable (not the dark l of 'feel'). Your tongue tip stays pressed just behind your upper teeth.
Each one is a single beat. Don't add a vowel: say 'mul', not 'mu-ru'.
ㄹ at the start of a syllable is a quick tap. As a final consonant, hold it.

exercises: Which word ends in a held [l] sound? ① 바 / 발 ② 고 / 골 ③ 그 / 글
Is the ㄹ a quick tap [r] or a held [l]? ① 라디오 ② 별 ③ 노래
Put the syllables in order to make a word: ① 울 / 겨 (winter) ② 실 / 교 (classroom) ③ 철 / 하 / 지 (subway)
Fill in the blank with 달, 발, or 귤: ① ____ 아파요. (My foot hurts.) ② 저기 ____ 보세요! (Look at the moon over there!) ③ ____ 하나 주세요. (One tangerine, please.)
answers: ① 발 ② 골 ③ 글
① tap [r] ② held [l] ③ tap [r]
① 겨울 ② 교실 ③ 지하철
① 발 ② 달 ③ 귤
